title: PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY TATE & LYLE INVESTMENTS LIMITED OF ENTIRE ISSUED SHARES IN CP KELCO APS
title_sw: PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY TATE & LYLE INVESTMENTS LIMITED OF ENTIRE ISSUED SHARES IN CP KELCO APS
text:
Tate & Lyle Investments Limited notified the Fair Competition Commission (“FCC”) of their intention to acquire entire issued shares in CP Kelco ApS, hence gaining indirect control of Zanea Seaweed Co. Limited’s registered branch in Tanzania Mainland.
The product market was defined as production and export of dried seaweed in Mainland Tanzania.
Upon analysis it was concluded that, pre- and post-merger scenarios will remain the same for both perspectives of Section 5 (6) (a) and (b) of the FCA and thus having no possibility of either creating or strengthening a position of dominance in the relevant market. The merger was approved.
